newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens wins 130 mln mark U.S. phone deal.
newsitem.headline: Siemens wins 130 mln mark U.S. phone deal.

text.p: German industrial group Siemens AG said on Monday its public telecommunications unit won a 130 million mark ($75 million) contract to supply mobile phone equipment to a U.S. customer.

The public networking (ON) unit, under a contract with Dipiph PCS Inc., of Mobile, Ala., would build a mobile phone and data system that touches parts of Florida, Alabama and Mississippi, Siemens said.

The system would use the so-called GSM digital technology that has become popular in Europe. Siemens said it was a breakthrough to win a contract for a GSM data network in the U.S., which has not yet settled on a single digital phone technology.
Construction would begin this summer and the network would begin operating by the end of the year, Siemens said.
